description.value: SSal Sushi & Grill is a Korean and sushi restaurant situated on Marine Drive in North Vancouver. OSM records both indoor and outdoor seating, placing it on a busy commercial corridor accessible to cyclists riding the North Shore waterfront routes. Beyond the OSM snapshot, no further detail about the business could be verified due to website compromise.

Because the website provides zero usable evidence for any amenity, all amenity fields default to null, and contact details cannot be confirmed via the website. OSM tags alone are insufficient to confirm cycling-specific criteria.
